purpose: Six image-only symbolic cinematic backgrounds for the Hock Siew tribute V4.
execution_mode: built-in; no API/CLI fallback; no Runway or provider purchases

reference.role: Style/material/palette/lighting reference only; viewed with view_image before generation; composition not copied.

native_output_note: Each prompt requested 1920x1080 16:9. Built-in tool returned 1672x941 PNGs, near 16:9. These are unmodified generated originals copied to workspace; 1080p film export must normalize framing/scale in the renderer.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: cinematic 16:9 film still, 1920x1080 landscape. Create a NEW distinct scene, using the attached image ONLY as STYLE reference for tactile ivory paper, aged bronze, ink blue-green/indigo accents and warm sunlight; do not repeat its bridge or composition. Scene 01 THE THREAD: an extreme macro landscape of a single thin cinnabar-red silk thread sweeping from the lower right across softly folded rich ivory handmade paper toward the upper left, delicate individual fibres and silk weave, a small weathered bronze binding detail at the far right edge. Grazing golden light and deep cinematic soft shadows make the paper terrain sculptural and expensive. Composition: left-centre 45 percent quiet broad flat ivory plane with subtle paper texture, fully empty to receive an unchanged real photo added later in code; arrange thread and relief details at its perimeter. Shallow macro focus at far foreground and distance but quiet plane sharp enough. Full bleed, no designed frame or picture placeholder. Elegant Chinese poetic art direction, touchable practical miniature feel, not a graphic slide. Absolutely no people, faces, bodies, hands, statues, silhouettes, letters, numbers, writing, calligraphy, labels, logos or watermark. Do not invent photographs or frames in the scene. One single restrained red silk line, no extra ribbons. Output only the artwork.
assets.visual_inspection: Accepted after viewing built-in result: extreme macro silk and bronze at right edge; broad quiet ivory left/centre plane; blue-green paper ridge edges; no visible person or writing.
